user.title: Yahoo Finance Setup
user.description:
Enter the symbols to track, separated by commas. Examples: AAPL, MSFT, ^GSPC, GBPUSD=X, EMIM.L

Note: This integration works best in US mainland. GDPR regions may experience failures.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to fetch prices from Yahoo Finance. Minimum 1 hour, maximum 24 hours.
data_description.symbols: Separate multiple symbols with commas or spaces. Use Yahoo Finance ticker format, e.g. AAPL, ^GSPC, GBPUSD=X, EMIM.L

error.no_symbols: Please enter at least one valid symbol.

init.title: Yahoo Finance Options
init.description: Update tracked symbols and configure display options.

data.show_trending_icon: Show trending icon (up/down/neutral) instead of currency icon
data.show_currency_symbol_as_unit: Show currency symbol (e.g. $) instead of code (e.g. USD) as unit
data.show_off_market_values: Show pre/post market price as main sensor value when market is closed
data.include_pre_values: Include pre-market price, change and time attributes
data.include_post_values: Include post-market price, change and time attributes

data_description.scan_interval: How often to fetch prices from Yahoo Finance. Minimum 1 hour, maximum 24 hours.
data_description.symbols: Separate multiple symbols with commas or spaces. Use Yahoo Finance ticker format, e.g. AAPL, ^GSPC, GBPUSD=X, EMIM.L
data_description.decimal_places: Number of decimal places to round prices to. Use -1 to disable rounding, 0 for whole numbers.

error.no_symbols: Please enter at least one valid symbol.

refresh_symbols.name: Refresh Symbols
refresh_symbols.description: Manually trigger a refresh of all Yahoo Finance symbol data.
